title: Tools
notFound: Not found (deleted, or belongs to another company)
homeTools: Tools whose home is this location ({n})
homeToolsEmpty: No tools have this location as home yet
transferNote: {name} currently holds this tool. Taking it out transfers it to you and notifies {name} (no return needed).
heldByMe: You hold this tool. Take out again to change the destination; scan a storage place QR to return it.
transferred: Holder transferred to you (previous holder notified)
saveFailed: Could not record. Check your connection and try again
recordedWithoutLocation: Recorded without location (recording works even when location is unavailable)
returnNotOut: This tool is not checked out (this will be recorded as placing it here)
returnHint: Scan the tool QR or pick from the list below. Anyone can return a tool.
geoIdle: Location is recorded as a deterrent (recording works without it)
geoRetryable: Could not get location (you can still record)
geoBlocked: Location is blocked. Allow it in device settings to record it (you can still record)
indexHint: Scan a tool or storage QR to take out / return. Here you can see where tools are now.
